description: Rewrite a resume so it passes ATS screening. Returns the rewritten resume, a projected ATS score, and an itemised summary of every change made. Pass job_description to tailor the rewrite to one specific posting, or omit it for general ATS optimization. Requires a connected GetMattered account. Uses the user's AI credits. Do not use it to apply: getmattered_apply tailors the resume for every application on its own. resume_text is optional: the user can paste or attach a resume in the chat, and you pass its text as resume_text. Without it, the tool uses the resume already on the user's account. In ChatGPT the user can attach a resume file; pass it as resume_file.

job_description.description: Full text of the target job description (optional, omit for general ATS optimization)

resume_file.description: In ChatGPT the user can attach a resume file; pass it as resume_file. It is downloaded once, right away: PDF, DOCX or plain text, up to 10 MB.

resume_text.description: Full text of the resume to optimize. The resume the user pasted or attached in this conversation, as plain text. Omit it to use the resume already on the user's GetMattered account.

name: getmattered_optimize_resume
title: Optimize Resume with AI
